data.markdown:
Security crawl-maze reproduction
================================

One page per linking construct; every expected endpoint lives under `/g32/test/` and answers 200. Categories:

*   [css](http://gym.test:4101/g32/css/)
     — font-face source in a stylesheet
*   [headers](http://gym.test:4101/g32/headers/)
     — Content-Location, Link, Location, Refresh
*   [html](http://gym.test:4101/g32/html/)
     — doctype, manifest, body and head constructs, inline URL strings
*   [javascript](http://gym.test:4101/g32/javascript/)
     — script strings and comments, framework-style bindings, click-driven requests
*   [misc](http://gym.test:4101/g32/misc/)
     — robots.txt and sitemap.xml known files
